postings: Senior Data Analyst - Northwind Health. Build dashboards in Tableau and write SQL against our warehouse. Python for analysis is a plus. Partner with stakeholders on KPIs and reporting. 5+ years of data analysis experience.

Data Analyst II - Contoso Retail. Own weekly reporting and dashboards. Strong SQL and Excel required. Experience with Tableau or Looker. Present findings to stakeholders. A/B testing experience preferred.
Senior Data Analyst - Fabrikam Logistics. SQL, Python and dbt to model shipment data. Build Tableau dashboards for operations leaders. Define KPIs and automate reporting.
Data Analyst - Tailspin Toys. Analyze sales data with SQL and Python. Create dashboards and reports for the commercial team. Stakeholder communication and A/B testing.
Senior Data Analyst, Product - Adventure Works. SQL and Python required; Tableau dashboards; experiment design and A/B testing; KPIs for product teams; reporting automation with dbt.
Business Data Analyst - Wide World Importers. Excel, SQL, reporting and dashboards for finance. Data analysis of margins and KPIs. Communicate insights to stakeholders.
Data Analyst (Healthcare) - Litware Clinics. SQL, Tableau, Python. Build clinical reporting dashboards. KPIs for clinic operations. Stakeholder communication with clinic managers.
Senior Data Analyst - Proseware. Lead data analysis for marketing. SQL, Python, Looker and dbt. A/B testing and KPIs. Dashboards and weekly reporting to leadership.
Data Analyst - Coho Winery. Excel and SQL reporting. Tableau dashboards for sales and inventory. Data analysis and stakeholder communication.
Analytics Engineer / Data Analyst - Woodgrove Bank. dbt, SQL and Python. Build reliable reporting models and dashboards. Define KPIs with finance stakeholders.
Senior Data Analyst - Alpine Ski House. SQL, Python, Tableau. Data analysis for bookings; dashboards; A/B testing of pricing; reporting to executives.
Data Analyst - Blue Yonder Airlines. SQL and Excel; reporting and dashboards for operations; KPIs; data analysis of on-time performance; Python a plus.
